historical_rule_retained.meaning: The earlier Jan-only rule and its prohibition on any February input remain part of the historical audit trail and describe the governance state before this amendment.

clauses: section 1.4 statements that every fresh or February use is SCOPE_BREACH
supersedes_only.replacement: The exact 2025-02-01 through 2025-02-28 score-only falsification is conditionally in scope after all seven P0 requirements are verified.

clauses: section 9.2.1A Jan-only scope and blanket February prohibition
supersedes_only.replacement: One exact frozen February receipt and one exact scoring attempt are conditionally in scope after the P0 release gate.

does_not_supersede: the requirement that January evidence is SEEN development-only E0-X
the separation from active G1 and future DEVELOPMENT, CALIBRATION, and HOLDOUT
the prohibition on H adjudication, champion selection, G2, paper, deployment, and trading claims
the requirement for exact artifact bindings, fail-closed data handling, and one-time consumption
scope_breach_conditions: a second authorization receipt or scoring attempt
fit, refit, calibration fit, tuning, threshold selection, state-boundary reselection, or model rescue
candidate or control replacement, cohort change, action change, cost change, or gate change
using a WAIT, STOP, FAILED, or COMPLETE February result to tune and rerun the same month
modifying active G1 or its Application Support evidence producer
claiming an H conclusion, market validation, profitability, champion, G2, paper readiness, deployment readiness, or trading permission

one_time_data_role_lifecycle.terminal_rule: Any February result, including WAIT_DATA_COVERAGE, STOP, FAILED, or COMPLETE, permanently consumes its independent-evaluation role and cannot be reopened by tuning.

required_before_new_version: assign a later non-overlapping HOLDOUT window
freeze one candidate after DEVELOPMENT and CALIBRATION
open the HOLDOUT once using a versioned receipt
sustainable_chronology_rule.development_use: Model and policy construction only within preregistered DEVELOPMENT.
sustainable_chronology_rule.calibration_use: Calibration only within preregistered CALIBRATION and before viewing HOLDOUT.
sustainable_chronology_rule.holdout_use: One-time evaluation of the frozen candidate; every viewed month remains permanently SEEN.
sustainable_chronology_rule.failure_policy: Retire or version the candidate and move to later data; never relax gates or rescue a failed candidate on the consumed month.

required_before_download: all seven P0 requirements mechanically verified
authorization receipt and authorized execution contract
P0 test report bound by SHA-256
post-fix runner, evaluator, and package bound by SHA-256
notice: This amendment removes one blanket February scope prohibition only. It does not assert P0 completion, authorize a download now, or upgrade January or February evidence beyond E0-X.
